scope: All525HEROES_DBuniverses; mode defaults measured without a concrete scene name. Concrete scene names override these reference defaults and may choose another profile or none.
mechanismGeometry: 24individually drawn scene mechanisms, without new image assets or backdrop composites.

preservationEvidence.note: Preservation SHA256 covers recorded Canvas commands at1040x460, without loading images. These are not screenshot/source-frame comparison hashes. Old files, bitmaps, reports and tests are not rewritten.

localAssetInventory.method: Read-only filename inventory for selected universes; filenames alone do not prove source frames or scene suitability. None is imported by the new profiles.

profiles.sourceWork: PAYDAY: The Heist (2011), First World Bank
profiles.sourceScene: First World Bank — perceuse de la grille de sécurité, PAYDAY The Heist 2011
profiles.continuity: Original 2011 security gate, before thermite; excludes the PAYDAY 2 remake and Overdrill
profiles.sceneEvidence: The indexed walkthrough distinguishes the security-gate drill from later thermite used on the vault floor. A clamped drill with a bounded sliding feed and rotating chuck interprets that gate operation. Exact casing, feed length and repeated unloaded cycle are authored; no door opens and no heist objective progresses.

profiles.sourceWork: PAYDAY 2 (2015), Golden Grin Casino, BFD
profiles.sourceScene: Golden Grin Casino — portique BFD, PAYDAY 2 2015
profiles.continuity: Golden Grin loud approach with the BFD assembled, before the breach; not stealth
profiles.sceneEvidence: The official DLC page explicitly names the customizable BFD. This distant gantry studies a suspended tool carriage and paired cooling rotors without claiming a source-verified cutter design. It deliberately omits a conventional screw-drill bit, drilling progress, turrets, heat, floor removal and heist effects.

profiles.sourceWork: Duke Nukem 3D (1996 DOS), Hollywood Holocaust projector room
profiles.sourceScene: Hollywood Holocaust — cabine de projection du cinéma, Duke Nukem 3D DOS 1996
profiles.continuity: Original DOS cinema projection booth, intact; no Duke Nukem 64 or World Tour layout
profiles.sceneEvidence: The level guide identifies the projection room and movie projector. Unequal take-up reels, film guides and a shutter rotate on fixed axles in this authored study. Film content and the screen are omitted; no source image, switch event, weapon pickup or destructible screen is reproduced.

profiles.sourceWork: Duke Nukem 3D (1996 DOS), Rabid Transit
profiles.sourceScene: Rabid Transit — train du métro entre les stations, Duke Nukem 3D DOS 1996
profiles.continuity: Original DOS Rabid Transit train; level numbering varies in the archived guide so none is asserted
profiles.sceneEvidence: The archived 3D Realms guide describes the train and subway stations. A closed distant rail circuit carries an empty two-bogie car with wheel rotations tied to travel. Track shape and car proportions are authored rather than a copied map; the train cannot be ridden or hit an actor.

profiles.sourceWork: Return to Castle Wolfenstein (2001 PC), Tram Ride
profiles.sourceScene: Tram Ride — cabine et poulies du téléphérique, Return to Castle Wolfenstein PC 2001
profiles.continuity: Original PC mission with working pulley mechanism, before the cable car is damaged
profiles.sceneEvidence: The opened level account describes activating a pulley mechanism and calling the cable car between stations. The empty carriage follows a fixed sloping cable and retains a vertical suspension. Wheel size, cabin geometry and smooth return cycle are authored; it carries no actors and changes no route or power state.

profiles.sourceWork: Wolfenstein: The New Order (2014), Eisenwald Prison cell block
profiles.sourceScene: Eisenwald Prison — ascenseur du bloc de cellules, The New Order 2014
profiles.continuity: 2014 main-game chapter 4 cell-block elevator before escape; not the coal loader itself
profiles.sceneEvidence: The guide specifically takes the cell-block elevator upward before entering cell B2. A caged empty lift, winding drum and opposing counterweight interpret that transport. Cage dimensions and shaft arrangement are authored; no door, alarm, prison population, escape flag or player elevation changes.

profiles.sourceWork: Poppy Playtime, Chapter 1: A Tight Squeeze (2021), Make-A-Friend
profiles.sourceScene: Make-A-Friend — trois distributeurs et convoyeur d’assemblage, chapitre 1 2021
profiles.continuity: Chapter 1 after restoring the machine power, before the chase; no later chapter machine
profiles.sceneEvidence: The walkthrough describes powering the console and pulling three levers to assemble a toy. Three hoppers with linked lever arms feed blank nonliving parts above an empty conveyor. Parts, proportions and repeat are authored; no toy character, inventory reward, door unlock or chase is triggered.

profiles.sourceWork: Poppy Playtime, Chapter 2: Fly in a Web (2022), Game Station
profiles.sourceScene: Game Station — pupitre à levier et train à quai, chapitre 2 2022
profiles.continuity: Chapter 2 Game Station before departure and derailment, not the Project: Playtime train
profiles.sceneEvidence: The guide identifies a lever on the train platform that opens access to Musical Memory. An empty train stays at the platform while that lever and an access shutter demonstrate an authored bounded maintenance motion. The door geometry and linkage are adapted; no train-code entry, minigame access, departure or crash happens.

profiles.sourceWork: Bendy and the Ink Machine, Chapter 1: Moving Pictures (2017)
profiles.sourceScene: Moving Pictures — machine à encre remise en marche, chapitre 1 2017
profiles.continuity: Original 2017 chapter 1 working machine before flooding, not the 2018 remastered room
profiles.sceneEvidence: The plot account establishes repairing and activating the Ink Machine before flooding; its release history distinguishes the first chapter. A guided piston, crank and bounded liquid indicator interpret that function. Their layout and continuous empty running cycle are authored; no ink flood, monster or gameplay trigger is added.

profiles.sourceWork: Bendy and the Ink Machine, Chapter 3: Rise and Fall (2017), Toy Machine Room
profiles.sourceScene: Heavenly Toys — engrenages et convoyeur de la Toy Machine Room, chapitre 3 2017
profiles.continuity: Chapter 3 toy production room after its gears are unclogged and belts powered
profiles.sceneEvidence: The indexed room entry describes powering the belts and removing objects from gears to unclog them; full opening failed. Two externally meshed equal gears turn oppositely and drive a blank belt. Shape, tooth count and safe repeat are authored; no mission objects are removed, generated or granted.

profiles.sourceWork: Atomic Heart (2023), Vavilov Complex Algae Workshop
profiles.sourceScene: Vavilov — atelier des algues, chariot circulant devant cinq moteurs, Atomic Heart 2023
profiles.continuity: Base-game Algae Workshop after restarting its platform, no DLC location
profiles.sceneEvidence: The guide specifies riding a cart around the pool and charging five motors, with the cart returning if missed. An empty carriage and five bounded motor shafts interpret that machinery. Their rail path and rotation are authored; no Shok, polymer filling, enemy spawn or canister progression occurs.

profiles.sourceWork: Atomic Heart (2023), A Glass, Darkly, exhibition mirror basement
profiles.sourceScene: VDNH exhibition — sous-sol du miroir, aimants de plafond et plateformes, Atomic Heart 2023
profiles.continuity: Base-game exhibition entrance magnetic rooms before the mirror opens, no DLC puzzle
profiles.sceneEvidence: The walkthrough describes ceiling magnet reversals moving red and blue platforms below the entrance mirror. Two empty racks move in opposition beneath fixed magnet housings; rack dimensions, support rods and timing are authored. Magnetic forces, puzzles, mirror state and traversable platforms are unchanged.

profiles.sourceWork: Horizon Zero Dawn (2017), Meridian southeastern elevators
profiles.sourceScene: Meridian — paire d’ascenseurs vers la ville basse, Horizon Zero Dawn 2017
profiles.continuity: Original game Meridian before the final attack; excludes collapsed/rebuilding elevators and remaster
profiles.sceneEvidence: The indexed walkthrough identifies a pair of large elevators on the southeastern mesa; full opening returned 403. Paired empty cages move within separate fixed guides and each has a constant-sum counterweight rope. Exact architecture and timing are authored; no actor is lifted and no city route changes.

profiles.sourceWork: Horizon Zero Dawn (2017), Cauldron SIGMA hovering assembly line
profiles.sourceScene: Cauldron SIGMA — chaîne d’assemblage flottante et barres suspendues, Horizon Zero Dawn 2017
profiles.continuity: Original SIGMA chamber hovering freight, not RHO turbines or another cauldron
profiles.sceneEvidence: The guide describes hovering devices and crates with bars underneath that Aloy can grab while they travel. Empty triangular carriers with fixed underbars follow an authored oval transport path. The route, scale and repeat are adapted; no grab anchor, machine enemy, cover vent or playable freight is created.

profiles.sourceWork: SCP-914 by Dr Gears, SCP Wiki primary article, research cell 109-B
profiles.sourceScene: SCP-914 — cellule de recherche 109-B, cabines et horlogerie
profiles.continuity: Primary SCP-914 article, research cell 109-B; no game-specific Site-02 or Site-19 layout asserted
profiles.sceneEvidence: Dr Gears’ CC BY-SA primary article specifies two booths linked by copper tubes, sliding doors, gears, a selection knob and mainspring key. Empty booth shutters and a winding key form an authored maintenance study. No refinement, item, anomalous output or claimed five-to-ten-minute operating sequence is simulated.

profiles.sourceWork: SCP-294 by Arcibi, SCP Wiki primary article, second-floor personnel break room
profiles.sourceScene: SCP-294 — distributeur de la salle de pause du deuxième étage
profiles.continuity: Primary article break room, no game-specific cafeteria or facility number asserted
profiles.sceneEvidence: Arcibi’s CC BY-SA primary article places the vending machine in the second-floor personnel break room and specifies QWERTY keys, a coin slot and a paper cup. A bounded cup feeder and plain water line are authored decorative interpretations; no anomalous retrieval, cost, drink, healing or inventory effect is produced.

profiles.sourceWork: Hellraiser (1987), Frank’s attic and the Lament Configuration
profiles.sourceScene: Grenier — panneaux coulissants de la Lament Configuration, Hellraiser 1987
profiles.continuity: Original 1987 film puzzle box before opening; excludes the 2022 mechanism and later configurations
profiles.sceneEvidence: The film-prop account explains sliding and rotating the box panels and discusses the original 1987 film. A small empty cube outline separates three interlocking panels and returns them along fixed guides. Ornament, projection and repeat are authored; it opens no portal and summons no character or chains.

profiles.sourceWork: Hellbound: Hellraiser II (1988), Leviathan above the Labyrinth
profiles.sourceScene: Labyrinthe — Léviathan en rotation, Hellbound Hellraiser II 1988
profiles.continuity: 1988 film suspended rotating form before it reverts; not the 2022 reboot
profiles.sceneEvidence: The indexed entry describes Leviathan as a massive rotating rhombus above the labyrinth; full opening failed. A projected faceted lozenge rotates over a distant maze outline. Facets, perspective and period are authored; its source beams, realm control, characters and puzzle transformations are not applied.

profiles.sourceScene: DM-Pressure — chambre de pression vide, Unreal Tournament UT99 1999
